new_question.question: Bringer uses Spirits May Yet Dream to turn an unearned Fear Card in the Fear deck face-up. Does turning it face-up immediately earn that card or let players resolve its Fear effect now, or must it still be earned and resolved normally?

new_key.answer: Turning it face-up only previews the card. It does not earn it or resolve its effect. The card is still earned and resolved normally, with its Fear effect waiting for the ordinary Fear resolution procedure after it is earned.
